Variable names
* Please standardise the variable names:
  • L, W, R and H are used in the Goal section, but H is undefined.
  • L, W and R are used in the Input and Constraints sections.
  • W, H and R are used in the stub generator.

Goal
* Please change "it's" to "its".

* Please change "Pz doesn't must be computed" to "z-coordinate is always 0".

* Please change "3D distance" to "3D Euclidean distance".

* Please change "≤" to "less than or equal to".

* Please remove the last sentence.

Output
* Line 1 & Line 2: Please change "ceil rounded" to "rounded up".

* Line 1: Please change "meter" to "meters".

* Line 2: Please change "meter" to "cubic meters".

* Line 3: Please explicitly specify that the output must be either {{true}} or {{false}}.

Cases
* Please update the following test cases so that Px ≠ Py:
  • Validator 3
  • Test 5

Thanks.
